mer_opportunity.name: Opportunity (MER-B)
mer_opportunity.summary: After touchdown at Eagle Crater, Opportunity traversed 45.16 km south-east across Meridiani Planum, exploring Endurance, Victoria, and Santa Maria craters before reaching Endeavour Crater rim and Perseverance Valley.

mer_spirit.name: Spirit (MER-A)
mer_spirit.summary: After touchdown at Columbia Memorial Station in Gusev Crater, Spirit traversed 7.73 km eastward into the Columbia Hills, ascended Husband Hill (+107m climb), and investigated hydrothermal deposits at Home Plate before its final stop at Troy.

cnsa_zhurong.name: Zhurong (Tianwen-1)
cnsa_zhurong.summary: After touchdown in Southern Utopia Planitia, Zhurong rolled off the landing platform and traveled 1.92 km southwards, investigating transverse aeolian ridges, polygon ground structures, and subsurface ice.

zhurong_tianwen1.name: Zhurong (Tianwen-1)
zhurong_tianwen1.summary: After touchdown in Southern Utopia Planitia, Zhurong rolled off the landing platform and traveled 1.92 km southwards, investigating transverse aeolian ridges, polygon ground structures, and subsurface ice.

pathfinder_sojourner.name: Mars Pathfinder (Sojourner)
pathfinder_sojourner.summary: After touchdown inside an airbag cocoon at Carl Sagan Memorial Station, Sojourner executed humanity's first robotic Mars drive (~131 m), analyzing volcanic boulders Barnacle Bill and Yogi rock.

milestones.name: Sol 1: Touchdown at Carl Sagan Station

m20_perseverance.name: Perseverance (Mars 2020)

final.name: Belva Crater Rim / Neretva Vallis (Active Location)

m20_perseverance.summary: After touchdown at Octavia E. Butler Landing, Perseverance has driven over 28.4 km across Jezero paleolake delta and Belva Crater rim, collecting sample tubes for Mars Sample Return.

milestones.name: Sol 1050: Belva Crater Rim Observation Point

msl_curiosity.name: Curiosity (MSL)

final.name: Gediz Vallis Debris Flow Ridge (Active Location)

msl_curiosity.summary: After touchdown at Bradbury Landing in Gale Crater, Curiosity has ascended over 32.8 km up Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), climbing Vera Rubin Ridge and exploring the sulfate-bearing canyon.

insight_lander.name: InSight Lander
insight_lander.summary: Stationary geophysics lander deployed at Homestead Hollow. 130 km × 27 km EDL targeted landing ellipse; localized 3m robotic arm instrument deployment workspace.

phoenix_landing_site.name: Phoenix Lander
phoenix_landing_site.summary: Stationary northern arctic permafrost excavator. 100 km × 20 km EDL landing ellipse in Vastitas Borealis.

viking1_lander.name: Viking 1 Lander
viking1_lander.summary: First operational Mars surface lander. 280 km × 100 km landing ellipse in Chryse Planitia.

viking2_lander.name: Viking 2 Lander
viking2_lander.summary: Stationary science station in Utopia Planitia volcanic plain. 280 km × 100 km landing ellipse.

beagle2_lander.name: Beagle 2 (Mars Express)
beagle2_lander.summary: Touchdown site in Isidis Planitia with 20 km × 10 km landing ellipse and solar panel deployment zone.

mars_3_lander.name: Mars 3 Lander
mars_3_lander.summary: Ptolemaeus Crater touchdown site; nominal 25 km × 15 km landing ellipse.

schiaparelli_edm.name: Schiaparelli EDM Lander
schiaparelli_edm.summary: Meridiani Planum impact zone footprint (15 km × 10 km target ellipse).

phoenix_lander.name: Phoenix Lander
phoenix_lander.summary: Stationary northern arctic permafrost excavator. 100 km × 20 km EDL landing ellipse in Vastitas Borealis.

viking_1.name: Viking 1 Lander
viking_1.summary: First operational Mars surface lander. 280 km × 100 km landing ellipse in Chryse Planitia.

viking_2.name: Viking 2 Lander
viking_2.summary: Stationary science station in Utopia Planitia volcanic plain. 280 km × 100 km landing ellipse.

beagle_2.name: Beagle 2 (Mars Express)
beagle_2.summary: Touchdown site in Isidis Planitia with 20 km × 10 km landing ellipse and solar panel deployment zone.

mars_6_lander.name: Mars 6 Lander (USSR)
mars_6_lander.summary: Descent module entered Martian atmosphere on March 12, 1974. Transmitted 224 seconds of atmospheric data during parachute descent before signal terminated near retro-rocket ignition.

mars_polar_lander.name: Mars Polar Lander (NASA)
mars_polar_lander.summary: Targeted landing near south polar layered deposits on December 3, 1999. Probable premature engine shutoff caused impact upon reaching the surface.
